images.filename: Cairn on Meall an t-Slugain - geograph.org.uk - 808181.jpg
images.caption:
Cairn on Meall an t-Slugain The cairn marking the top of Meal an t-Slugain has been extended with a low wall to provide shelter from the wind. On this sunny afternoon it wasn't needed.
The top gives a good view of Lochnagar. To the right of it, the vertical north edge of Carn a' Choire Bhoidheach can just be seen.
images.alt:
Cairn on Meall an t-Slugain The cairn marking the top of Meal an t-Slugain has been extended with a low wall to provide shelter from the wind. On this sunny afternoon it wasn't needed.
The top gives a good view of Lochnagar. To the right of it, the vertical north edge of Carn a' Choire Bhoidheach can just be seen.

images.caption:
Lochnagar from Glen Gelder The main attraction of Glen Gelder is views it gives of Lochnagar from the south. On this day the light was against us. Only as we left was it possible to take a picture without looking into the sun.
The track in the foreground runs from Easter Balmoral through Glen Gelder and down to Spittal of Glenmuick.
images.alt:
Lochnagar from Glen Gelder The main attraction of Glen Gelder is views it gives of Lochnagar from the south. On this day the light was against us. Only as we left was it possible to take a picture without looking into the sun.
